ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:3 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) pigmentation is concentrated on the distal lobes. The left lobe contains a large, irregular white geometric blob with internal dark speckling. The right lobe features a high-intensity band along the trailing edge that tapers towards the notch. The central and basal regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced at the distal tips of both lobes, smoothing out as the boundary approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a primary concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in a sharp convex curvature at the outer extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters on the dark central peduncle area; several dark circular clusters are visible within the high-intensity white field of the left distal lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of at least three distinct, sub-parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake mark scarring on the left lobe and irregular tissue loss/jaggedness at the tip of the left lobe trailing edge.
